age.evidence: Male ICR mice (20-25 g) were obtained from Japan SLC Inc.

sex.evidence: Male ICR mice (20-25 g) were obtained from Japan SLC Inc.

dosing.evidence: DOI (1 and 3 mg/kg, s.c.) conditioning ... twice daily for 3 days; acute administration of DOI (0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg, s.c.)

handling.evidence: Methods do not mention handling protocol.

group_housing.evidence: Unless otherwise stated, the mice were group-housed (3-6 mice).

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.).

enrichment_housing.evidence: Methods do not address home-cage enrichment.

assays.assay_description: Two-compartment shuttle box (15 × 30 × 15 cm) with white/textured vs black/smooth compartments. Preconditioning trial, 3 days of conditioning (saline AM, drug PM, 30 min each), and post-conditioning tests of 15 min on Days 4, 7, and 14. Time spent in each compartment recorded by infrared beam sensor.

setup_habituation.evidence: Preconditioning test (Day -1) used directly as baseline; no separate apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animal placed in centre of two compartments, free to move between them.

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (in home cage); no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (in home cage); no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: The postconditioning tests were performed on Days 4, 7, and 14.

sample_size.evidence: Each column represents the mean scores with S.E.M. of eight to ten animals (U50,488H) / ten to twelve animals (DOI).

outcomes.summary: DOI (3 mg/kg, s.c.) produced significant place aversion on Day 4 compared with saline controls, but the aversive effect was absent on Days 7 and 14. U50,488H (1 mg/kg) similarly produced aversion on Days 4 and 7.
outcomes.statistics: DOI 3 mg/kg p < 0.01 (Day 4, Dunnett's); U50,488H 1 mg/kg p < 0.01 (Day 4), p < 0.05 (Day 7).
outcomes.evidence: The DOI 3 mg/kg group had a significant CPA score compared with the saline control group on Day 4 (3 mg/kg; p < 0.01; daily statistics), but not on Days 7 and 14.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Single CPA score calculated from time spent in drug- vs vehicle-paired compartment.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total time spent in each compartment during 900 s session reported; no within-session time course.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Zone preference (time in compartment) is a spatial measure, not an ethological behaviour.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Conditioned place aversion requires learned drug-context association.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automatically recorded with an infrared beam sensor (Supermex sensor).

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate ANOVA with Dunnett's reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: shuttle box (15 cm wide × 30 cm long × 15 cm high) made of acrylic resin board

E2_shelter.evidence: Two open compartments; no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: Textured or smooth floor; no bedding in apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in CPP compartments.

E6_spatial.evidence: divided into two compartments of equal size

E7_social_context.evidence: An animal ... was placed in the center of the two compartments.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in apparatus during 15 min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Preconditioning test plus postconditioning tests on Days 4, 7, and 14.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Preconditioning (Day -1) plus postconditioning tests on Days 4, 7, and 14 = 4 recording days.

D4_baseline.evidence: The preconditioning test was performed ... time spent ... was automatically recorded.

D5_followup.evidence: Postconditioning tests on Days 4, 7, and 14 without drug administration.

assays.assay_description: Polycarbonate cage (28 × 44 × 20.5 cm) with 5 cm-deep paper bedding and 25 blue glass marbles in a 5×5 grid. Mice placed for 30 min after drug administration; marbles buried to ≥2/3 depth counted at 15 and 30 min from overhead photographs. Performed acutely and 1 h after CPA test on Days 4, 7, and 14.

application_type.evidence: U50,488H (0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg, s.c.) and DOI (0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg, s.c.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Each mouse was placed in a cage for 30 min immediately after drug administration.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each mouse was placed in a cage ... freely moving.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in test cage; ad libitum in home cage.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in test cage; ad libitum in home cage.

time_to_assay.evidence: after a single administration, and also on Days 4, 7 and 14 after the CPA test (1 h after the CPA test session).

sample_size.evidence: Each column represents the mean counts with S.E.M. of nine (U50,488H acute) and 14 to 16 (DOI acute) animals; 8-10 (U50,488H post-CPA) and 10-12 (DOI post-CPA).

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI and U50,488H dose-dependently reduced marble-burying at 15 and 30 min compared with saline. In contrast, when re-tested 1 h after the CPA test on Day 4 (and Day 7 for DOI), animals previously conditioned with DOI or U50,488H showed an INCREASE in marble burying versus saline-conditioned controls.
outcomes.statistics: Acute DOI: 15 min (0.3 mg/kg p<0.05, 1 mg/kg p<0.01) and 30 min (1 mg/kg p<0.01, 3 mg/kg p<0.01). Post-CPA Day 4: increased burying (DOI 1 and 3 mg/kg p<0.05 at 30 min; 3 mg/kg p<0.05 at 15 min). Day 7: DOI 3 mg/kg p<0.05 at 15 min.
outcomes.evidence: There was a significant reduction in the number of buried marbles for all doses of DOI at 15 (0.3 mg/kg; p < 0.05, 1 mg/kg; p < 0.01) and 30 min (1 mg/kg; p < 0.01, 3 mg/kg; p < 0.01) compared with the saline control group. ... On Day 4, the number of buried marbles was significantly greater than that in the saline control for 15 (3 mg/kg; p < 0.05) and 30 min (1 and 3 mg/kg; p < 0.05) in the DOI conditioning groups.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of marbles buried (single measure, counted at two time points).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The number of marbles buried by the mice was then counted after 15 and 30 min.

B4_ethological.evidence: Marble burying is a natural rodent burrowing/digging behaviour.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Marbles counted manually from overhead photographs.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Polycarbonate cages (28 × 44 × 20.5 cm) — standard marble-burying apparatus.

E3_bedding.evidence: evenly distributed on 5 cm-deep paper animal bedding (Paper Clean)

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are the test stimuli, not enrichment objects.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single polycarbonate cage with no internal partitions.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was placed in a cage

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water present in test cage.

D1_continuity.evidence: Marble-burying after acute administration and 1 h after CPA test on Days 4, 7, and 14.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Each mouse was placed in a cage for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Acute test day plus Days 4, 7, and 14 = 4 recording days.

D5_followup.evidence: Marble-burying assessed on Days 4, 7, 14 after CPA conditioning (≥24 h post-dose).

judge_notes: Only DOI is scored as the psychedelic compound; U50,488H is a kappa-opioid agonist (not in the rubric's psychedelic list) but was administered in the same assays — assay scoring is unchanged because the paradigms are identical.

Schedule for CPA = repeated (3 days of conditioning); marble-burying acute test = acute, post-CPA marble-burying = repeated. Single dosing entry uses 'repeated' to cover the dominant CPA conditioning regimen.

E1 for marble-burying scored 0 (Standard apparatus) following the modal interpretation — marble-burying cage with bedding is the standard apparatus for this assay; gptoss's 'Enriched arena' was an outlier.
E5 for marble-burying scored 0: marbles are the test stimuli (NOR-style 'novel object used AS the test' analogue), not enrichment.
Time-to-assay for CPA set to short_term_1to7d (first post-conditioning test on Day 4 = ~24 h after last conditioning dose); marble-burying = multiple (acute at 0 min and follow-ups on Days 4/7/14).
Direction for marble-burying scored 'mixed' because acute administration decreased burying while post-CPA testing increased burying.
